articles.summary: KALISPELL, Mont., Nov. 12, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Glacier Bancorp, Inc.'s (NYSE: GBCI) Board of Directors, at a meeting held on November 12, 2025, declared a quarterly dividend of $0.33 per share.
